in_hebrew.name: Cobby
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Diminutive form of Cob, meaning 'horseshoe'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cobby הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In ancient Greece, the name Cob was given to those who were skilled in crafting horseshoes. The diminutive form, Cobby, was used as a term of endearment for those who possessed this valuable skill. In Christian tradition, the name Cobby may also symbolize strength and protection, as a horseshoe shields a horse's hooves from harm.
